---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

main_df <- read_excel("log_transformed_df_Pariwise_reGroup_plot_AllTaxa.xlsx", sheet = "df")
p_value_df <- read_excel("wilcoxon_results_with_rank_biserial_effect_size_one_tailed.xlsx", sheet = "Combined")

# Rename columns for consistency
colnames(p_value_df) <- c("Feature", "group1", "group2", "Wilcoxon_Stat", "p_value", "Effect_Size", "Effect_Size_abs")

# Remove NA p-values and filter target comparisons
p_value_df <- p_value_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value), group1 == "Baseline", group2 %in% c("FollUp", "EndMTT"))

desired_timepoints <- c("Baseline", "Vanco", "IniMTT", "EndMTT", "FollUp", "pl_Baseline", "pl_NoVanco", "pl_IniPart1", "pl_EndMTT")
display_labels <- c(
  "Baseline" = "Baseline",
  "Vanco" = "Vanco",
  "IniMTT" = "StartMT",
  "EndMTT" = "EndMT",
  "FollUp" = "FollUp",
  "pl_Baseline" = "pl_Baseline",
  "pl_NoVanco" = "pl_Vanco",
  "pl_IniPart1" = "pl_StartMT",
  "pl_EndMTT" = "pl_EndMT"
)

selected_pathways <- unique(p_value_df$Feature)

# Prepare main dataframe
analysis_df <- main_df %>% select(c("SampleID", "PatientID", "TreatPoints", "Category", all_of(selected_pathways)))

# Filter non-donor and TD samples
analysis_df_filtered <- analysis_df %>% filter(!TreatPoints %in% c("Donor", "TD"))

# Create donor/TD frames for line reference
donor_df <- analysis_df %>% filter(TreatPoints == "Donor")
td_df <- analysis_df %>% filter(TreatPoints == "TD")

# Calculate mean values for Donor and TD
donor_means <- data.frame(Feature = names(colMeans(donor_df[, sapply(donor_df, is.numeric)], na.rm = TRUE)),
                          mean = as.numeric(colMeans(donor_df[, sapply(donor_df, is.numeric)], na.rm = TRUE)))
td_means <- data.frame(Feature = names(colMeans(td_df[, sapply(td_df, is.numeric)], na.rm = TRUE)),
                       mean = as.numeric(colMeans(td_df[, sapply(td_df, is.numeric)], na.rm = TRUE)))

# Filter for Treated and Placebo only
analysis_df_filtered <- analysis_df_filtered %>% filter(Category %in% c("Treated", "Placebo"))

# Factor levels for consistent order
analysis_df_filtered$TreatPoints <- factor(
  analysis_df_filtered$TreatPoints,
  levels = c("Baseline", "Vanco", "IniMTT", "EndMTT", "FollUp", "pl_Baseline", "pl_NoVanco", "pl_IniPart1", "pl_EndMTT", "Donor", "TD")
)

# Reshape Data
analysis_long_df <- analysis_df_filtered %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(SampleID, PatientID, TreatPoints, Category), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  mutate(Abundance = as.numeric(Abundance))

plot_list <- list()

palette <- c(
  "Baseline" = "#27b85c", "Vanco" = "#27b85c", "IniMTT" = "#27b85c", "EndMTT" = "#27b85c",
  "pl_Baseline" = "purple", "pl_NoVanco" = "purple", "pl_IniPart1" = "purple", "FollUp" = "#27b85c",
  "pl_EndMTT" = "purple"
)

# Loop through each Feature to generate plots
for (taxon in selected_pathways) {
  plot_df <- analysis_long_df %>% filter(Feature == taxon, TreatPoints %in% desired_timepoints)
  plot_df$TreatPoints <- factor(plot_df$TreatPoints, levels = desired_timepoints)
  
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(GroupBlock = case_when(
      TreatPoints %in% c("Baseline", "Vanco", "IniMTT", "EndMTT", "FollUp") ~ "Treatment",
      TreatPoints %in% c("pl_Baseline", "pl_NoVanco", "pl_IniPart1", "pl_EndMTT") ~ "Placebo",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  
  line_df <- plot_df %>% group_by(PatientID, GroupBlock) %>% filter(n_distinct(TreatPoints) > 1) %>% ungroup()
  
  donor_mean_val <- donor_means %>% filter(Feature == taxon) %>% pull(mean)
  td_mean_val <- td_means %>% filter(Feature == taxon) %>% pull(mean)
  
  stat_test <- p_value_df %>%
    filter(Feature == taxon) %>%
    mutate(
      group1 = factor(group1, levels = levels(analysis_df_filtered$TreatPoints)),
      group2 = factor(group2, levels = levels(analysis_df_filtered$TreatPoints)),
      xmin = as.numeric(group1),
      xmax = as.numeric(group2),
      y.position = max(plot_df$Abundance, na.rm = TRUE) + seq(0.05, 0.05 * n(), length.out = n()),
      label = sprintf("p=%.2f (r.es=%.1f)", p_value, Effect_Size_abs)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(xmin) & !is.na(xmax))
  
  if (nrow(plot_df) > 0 && nrow(stat_test) > 0) {
    legend_df <- data.frame(
      x = rep(Inf, 2),
      y = c(donor_mean_val, td_mean_val),
      source = c("Donor (mean)", "TD (mean)")
    )
    
    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = TreatPoints, y = Abundance)) +
      geom_boxplot(aes(fill = TreatPoints), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
      geom_point(
        aes(group = PatientID, fill = TreatPoints),
        position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.6),
        shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.5, colour = "black"
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = line_df,
        aes(x = TreatPoints, y = Abundance, group = interaction(PatientID, GroupBlock)),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
        linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25, color = "gray50"
      ) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = donor_mean_val, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, color = "#3f7004") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = td_mean_val, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, color = "#579aff") +
      geom_point(
        data = legend_df,
        aes(x = x, y = y, color = source),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 2
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(name = " ", values = c("Donor (mean)" = "#3f7004", "TD (mean)" = "#579aff")) +
      guides(color = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(linetype = "dashed", shape = NA))) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = palette, labels = display_labels) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = display_labels) +
      stat_pvalue_manual(
        data = stat_test, label = "label", xmin = "xmin", xmax = "xmax", y.position = "y.position",
        tip.length = 0.01, step.increase = 0.05, size = 4.6
      ) +
      labs(y = bquote(italic(.(taxon)) ~ "(log10 RA)"), x = NULL) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black", face = "plain", size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", face = "plain", size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "plain", size = 16),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 13)
      ) +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1), color = guide_legend(order = 2))
    
    plot_list[[taxon]] <- p
  } else {
    message(paste("Skipping:", taxon, "— No valid data or comparisons"))
  }
}

pdf("Longitudinal_boxplots_with_p-values.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
for (plot in plot_list) print(plot)
dev.off()
```
